jobs.employer_name: BIPS Institut f. Epidemiologie u.Präventionsforschg GmbH
jobs.description: Job announcementThe Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS GmbH invites applications for several positions (depending upon funding) to be filled asPhD in prevention research (m/f/d/x)Salary scale 13 TV-L (70% position).Starting from January 1, 2027 or later for the duration of 3 years (extension possible).In the coming years, the Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS will expand its research into the prevention of chronic, non-communicable diseases across the life course. The focus is on factors beyond individual diseases, such as lifestyle and environment, digital media, biological and social factors, as well as early detection. Existing large cohort studies based on primary data based will be used (e.g., IDEFICS/I.Family cohort study, NAKO Health Study), a birth cohort will be established and secondary data (health claims data) will be analyzed. Further, implementation and interventional research will be conducted to develop and evaluate innovative strategies for targeted prevention. The research is cross-departmental and involves all scientific departments of BIPS.In this context, we are looking for several PhD students with interest in at least one of the following areas:• Epidemiology with a focus on primary data• Epidemiological research based on health claims data• Implementation science• Health decision scienceTasks:• Coordinate and participate in research projects• Data analysis and interpretation of results• Publish and present research results• Support reporting of resultsRequirements:• Master’s degree (or equivalent including ‘Staatsexamen’) in one of the areas mentioned above or related disciplines• Good command of spoken and written English• Strong interest in interdisciplinary research• Initiative, motivation, commitment, and scientific curiosityWhat we offer:The Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS offers exciting research topics, a stimulating international environment, a good infrastructure, close ties to the University of Bremen and an engaged, supportive and cooperative team. Postdocs are encouraged to strive for scientific independence and to establish their own research focus. BIPS holds the audit ‘berufundfamilie’ (work and family) certificate and actively promotes the compatibility of career and individual lifestyle through flexible working hours, mobile working options, and continuous professional development. We also offer additional support for international scholars to relocate to Germany through the Welcome Center of the U Bremen Research Alliance.Among equally qualified applicants, preference will be given to severely disabled candidates.Enquiries to: Dr. Wiebke Schäfer, phone: +49 421 218 56 887Additional information can be found on our homepage: https://www.leibniz-bips.de/en.Please send your application in English or German including a cover letter, CV and certificates quoting the reference number A26-33 and mention at least of one of the topics above by November 27, 2026 by e-mail as a single PDF file to:bewerbung@leibniz-bips.dePlease note that applications which do not comply with the required format (1 PDF document) cannot be considered.For information on salaries, please refer to the TV-L salary calculator for 2026; the position is classified under pay grade E13 of the TV-L. Salary calculator: https://oeffentlicher-dienst.info/c/t/rechner/tv-l/allg?id=tv-l-2026Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS GmbH Human Resources Department Achterstr. 30 28359 Bremen GermanyErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Evaluation, Gesundheitsvorsorge (Prävention)

jobs.occupation: PhD Researcher (m/f/d) AI for Semantic Structures, Reasoning Flows & Personalized Content Generation (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: Become a part of our journey and join the Constructor Community as:PhD Researcher (m/f/d): AI for Semantic Structures, Reasoning Flows & Personalized Content GenerationYou are expected to contribute to the development of internationally visible, foundational research in AI-driven semantic structure extraction, automated reasoning-flow modeling, and adaptive content generation. The research focuses on methods for analyzing and representing deep semantic and pedagogical structures in scientific and educational materials; high-fidelity extraction of conceptual and reasoning blocks; inference-time rationale generation; and adaptive, learner-aware sequencing of content. This includes work on semantic parsing, structured NLP, graph-based neural models, metacognitive prompting, ontology alignment across disciplines, and human-in-the-loop optimization.In this context, interdisciplinary research is strongly encouraged—particularly collaborations spanning computer science, computational linguistics, cognitive science, and the learning sciences. You will contribute to developing datasets, baseline models, personalized learning engines, reasoning-graph representations, cross-domain mapping algorithms, and RLHF-style feedback loops that improve system interpretability and instructional quality. The successful candidate will also contribute to high-quality publications, release research prototypes, and support demonstrator systems that deliver structured semantic extraction, rationale-aware content generation, and cross-domain transfer of reasoning structures.Additionally, the successful candidate is expected to support teaching activities in areas such as Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, AI in Education, Knowledge Representation, and Python-based analytical seminars at the BSc, MSc, and PhD levels. Responsibilities include assisting in course delivery, advising students, supervising Bachelor/Master theses, and engaging in methodological innovation for online, hybrid, and in-person learning environments. The university provides strong support for early-career researchers, including mentorship, administrative assistance, access to computational resources, conference funding, and opportunities to collaborate with other research groups and industrial partners working at the intersection of AI and digital education.Your Profile- Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics, or a related field.- Strong research interest and practical experience in one or more of the following areas: - semantic parsing and structured representation learning- knowledge graphs or graph-based reasoning- transformer models, sequence modeling, or GNNs- natural language generation and explainability- educational AI, personalization algorithms, or cognitive modeling- Evidence of research potential through publications, a strong thesis, or significant projects.- Experience or interest in innovative teaching and learning approaches.- Ability to translate theoretical insights into engineered prototypes and systems supporting scientific or educational use cases.- Responsible, self-motivated, and capable of working independently as well as collaboratively.- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.- Intercultural competence and experience in international environments.- Fluency with co-pilot tools for coding and writing.- Fluency in English, the language of instruction and communication on campus.Funding & Appointment TermsThe appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:- Monthly stipend of €1,650- Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)- Health-insurance subsidy of €100 per month- Supplementary €550 mini-job allowance to support parallel part-time employment (optional)Application Details- Expected start date: February, 2026Application package must include:- Curriculum Vitae (CV)- Academic transcripts- A detailed letter of motivation outlining research interests and career goals- 2 recommendation lettersApplications to be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interviews.

At our locations in Hofheim, Lorsbach, Sulzbach, Eppstein, Marxheim, Schmitten and Feldberg, we accompany children from 6 months to 6 years of age as they grow into confident, curious and independent individuals.At Glückskinder, every child mattersOur educational approach combines the principles of Montessori – “Help me to do it myself” – with the philosophy of Emmi Pikler.We create an environment where children have the freedom to explore, discover, experiment and develop at their own pace.Through our language immersion approach, English becomes a natural part of everyday life. Children learn the language playfully and naturally through meaningful interactions, routines and experiences.As an educator with excellent English skills, you will be the English-speaking specialist within your group, communicating with the children in English throughout their daily routine and supporting them with enthusiasm, creativity and empathy.What you can expect from usA truly bilingual environmentYou will actively support the children's development in English while putting our educational principles into practice and responding to each child's individual needs.Time for quality educationObservation and documentation are an important part of our work. We give you the time and space you need to thoughtfully accompany and document each child's development.Continuous professional developmentWe believe in lifelong learning. Regular training opportunities and 8 dedicated concept days per year allow you to strengthen your pedagogical expertise and develop both personally and professionally.An international teamYou will become part of a diverse and international team where different cultures, experiences and perspectives are valued. We encourage you to bring your own ideas and make a difference.Digital & uncomplicatedOur Glückskinder app takes care of many everyday administrative processes, giving you more time and energy for what really matters: the children.Attractive salary & additional benefitsWe value your work and commitment. In addition to a performance-related salary, you can look forward to benefits such as a company pension scheme, travel allowance, JobRad and other attractive extras.🌴 Flexibility when planning your vacationWith only a few annual closing periods, you have greater flexibility when planning your holidays and can better balance work and personal life.✨ What you bring- A completed qualification as an Early Childhood Educator / Educator or a degree in Education, Early Childhood Education or a related field- Excellent English skills and a genuine enthusiasm for speaking English with children every day- German language skills at B1 level are essential- A passion for working with young children aged 6 months to 6 years- Empathy, responsibility and strong pedagogical skills- Creativity and plenty of ideas to make everyday learning exciting- Openness to new educational approaches and a willingness to continuously learn and developJoin the Glückskinder family – and help children grow, discover and flourish.----------------------------------------------------Englischsprachige Erzieher/in (m/w/d) mit hervorragenden EnglischkenntnissenWerde Teil der Glückskinder-Familie!Du liebst die Arbeit mit Kindern, sprichst sehr gut Englisch und möchtest Teil eines modernen, internationalen und inspirierenden pädagogischen Umfelds sein? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!Glückskinder GmbH ist ein privater Träger von Kindertagesstätten im Main-Taunus- und Hochtaunuskreis. An unseren Standorten in Hofheim, Lorsbach, Sulzbach, Eppstein, Marxheim, Schmitten und Feldberg begleiten wir Kinder im Alter von 6 Monaten bis 6 Jahren auf ihrem Weg zu selbstbewussten, neugierigen und selbstständigen Persönlichkeiten.Bei Glückskinder zählt jedes KindUnser pädagogisches Konzept verbindet die Grundsätze der Montessori-Pädagogik – „Hilf mir, es selbst zu tun“ – mit der Philosophie von Emmi Pikler.Wir schaffen eine Umgebung, in der Kinder die Freiheit haben, zu entdecken, zu erforschen, auszuprobieren und sich in ihrem eigenen Tempo zu entwickeln.Durch unseren Sprachimmersionsansatz wird Englisch zu einem natürlichen Bestandteil des Alltags. Die Kinder lernen die Sprache spielerisch und ganz selbstverständlich durch bedeutungsvolle Interaktionen, Routinen und gemeinsame Erfahrungen.Als pädagogische Fachkraft mit sehr guten Englischkenntnissen bist du die englischsprachige Fachkraft in deiner Gruppe. Du kommunizierst während des gesamten Tagesablaufs auf Englisch mit den Kindern und begleitest sie mit Begeisterung, Kreativität und Einfühlungsvermögen.Das erwartet dich bei unsEine bilinguale UmgebungDu unterstützt aktiv die Entwicklung der Kinder in englischer Sprache, setzt dabei unsere pädagogischen Grundsätze um und gehst individuell auf die Bedürfnisse jedes Kindes ein.Zeit für hochwertige pädagogische ArbeitBeobachtung und Dokumentation sind wichtige Bestandteile unserer Arbeit. Wir geben dir die notwendige Zeit und den Raum, um die Entwicklung jedes Kindes bewusst zu begleiten und zu dokumentieren.Kontinuierliche WeiterbildungWir glauben an lebenslanges Lernen. Regelmäßige Fortbildungen und 8 fest eingeplante Konzepttage pro Jahr geben dir die Möglichkeit, deine pädagogischen Kompetenzen zu erweitern und dich persönlich sowie beruflich weiterzuentwickeln.Ein internationales TeamDu wirst Teil eines vielfältigen und internationalen Teams, in dem unterschiedliche Kulturen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven geschätzt werden. Wir ermutigen dich, deine eigenen Ideen einzubringen und etwas zu bewegen.Digital & unkompliziertUnsere Glückskinder-App übernimmt viele organisatorische Aufgaben im Alltag und gibt dir dadurch mehr Zeit und Energie für das, worauf es wirklich ankommt: die Kinder.Attraktives Gehalt & zusätzliche LeistungenWir schätzen deine Arbeit und dein Engagement. Neben einem leistungsorientierten Gehalt erwarten dich unter anderem eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, ein Fahrtkostenzuschuss, JobRad und weitere attraktive Zusatzleistungen.🌴 Flexible UrlaubsplanungDa es nur wenige festgelegte Schließzeiten pro Jahr gibt, hast du mehr Flexibilität bei der Planung deines Urlaubs und kannst Beruf und Privatleben besser miteinander vereinbaren.✨ Das bringst du mit- Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Erzieher/in oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bzw. ein Studium im Bereich Pädagogik, Frühpädagogik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet- Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und echte Freude daran, täglich mit Kindern Englisch zu sprechen- Deutschkenntnisse auf B1-Niveau sind zwingend erforderlich- Leidenschaft für die Arbeit mit Kindern im Alter von 6 Monaten bis 6 Jahren- Einfühlungsvermögen, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und ausgeprägte pädagogische Fähigkeiten- Kreativität und viele Ideen, um den Alltag und das Lernen abwechslungsreich und spannend zu gestalten- Offenheit für neue pädagogische Ansätze sowie die Bereitschaft, dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickelnWerde Teil der Glückskinder-Familie – und hilf Kindern dabei, zu wachsen, zu entdecken und sich zu entfalten.

jobs.occupation: Ph.D. Researcher (m/f/d) Knowledge Discovery: From Unstructured Data to Shared Cognitive Maps (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: Constructor University (formerly Jacobs University) is a private, state-accredited, English-language university in Bremen. We offer Bachelor, Master, and PhD programs in three schools: School of Science, School of Computer Science and Engineering, and School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences. Our principles are first-class teaching and research, international diversity, and transdisciplinary cooperation. According to the 2024 Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings, Constructor University is among the top 25 percent out of more than 1900 universities worldwide and is ranked as the second most international university in the world. As an international university, we attract highly talented and open-minded students from all over the world. Currently, over 1,600 students from 110 nations live and study on our residential campus.The research group led by Prof. Dr. Andrey Ustyuzhanin at Constructor University, in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL) and Constructor Technology (industry partner), invites applications for Ph.D. student positions in the field of Computer Science, with a focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML).This PhD position is part of an initiative to advance knowledge representation and adaptive reasoning systems. The research will focus on developing flexible frameworks for actionable knowledge representation that support storage, retrieval, and dynamic adaptation of information across diverse tasks.Key objectives include:- Transforming unstructured data into interactive knowledge graphs and personalized cognitive maps.- Designing models that provide interpretable, persistent, and navigable structures of knowledge.- Addressing challenges such as hierarchy, composability, and coarse-graining for robust, task-specific reasoning.- Exploring individual and community-level knowledge modeling, including personalized domain maps, profile extraction from artifacts (e.g., papers, courses), and cross-domain abstraction.The overarching goal is to create systems that enable transparent, adaptive, and spatially intuitive representations of knowledge, supporting both individual users and collaborative communities.Your Profile:- Holding recognized MSc degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related discipline.- Students holding BSc degree and exhibiting outstanding performance and extraordinary potential can apply for fast-track PhD.- Strong mathematical background supported with experience in defining and developing knowledge-graph or information retrieval systems.- Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs) and their applications.- A track record of publications in AI/ML or related areas.- Documented experience in practical research work.- Strong skills in academic English writing (peer-reviewed papers, reports, or equivalent).Funding & Appointment TermsThe appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:- Monthly stipend of €1,650- Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)- Health-insurance subsidy of €100 per month- Supplementary €550 mini-job allowance to support parallel part-time employment (optional)Application Details- Expected start date: February, 2027Application package must include:- Curriculum Vitae (CV)- Academic transcripts- A detailed letter of motivation outlining research interests and career goals- 2 recommendation lettersApplications to be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interviews.
